title: Synthesis, characterization, antioxidant and anticancer potential of Kalanchoe pinnata green synthesized silver nanoparticles targeting p53/MDM2 nexus in hepatic cancer: integrated in vitro and in silico study.
authors: Moin, Afrasim; Hussain, Talib; Alafnan, Ahmed; Alamri, Abdulwahab; Alghamdi, Saeed; Rizvi, Syed Mohd Danish; Anwar, Sirajudheen; Chadha, Muskan; Khalid, Mohammad; Tiwari, Rohit Kumar; Ahmad, Afza
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物合成银纳米颗粒的抗氧化与抗癌活性，仅含少量p53/MDM2分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Globally, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is among the most commonly diagnosed cancers presenting complex treatment modalities. However, the side effects associated with conventional HCC therapeutics are quite detrimental, emphasizing the need to explore alternative therapeutics for the disease. The present report focuses on synthesis, characterization and investigation of the multifunctional biopotential of silver nanoparticles (AgNPs), biosynthesized using Kalanchoe pinnata ethanolic leaf extract (Kp-EtOH). The synthesized nanoparticles (Kp-AgNPs) were characterized by dynamic light scattering (DLS), TEM and FTIR. Results showed that Kp-AgNPs had an average hydrodynamic radius of 4.74 +/- 1.41 nm, and a zeta potential of 23.91 +/- 0.75 mV, indicative of good stabiliy. TEM images revealed the overall morphology of Kp-AgNPs as being spherical, and the FT-IR analysis showed widening of the peak at  approximately 3200 cm-1 indicating the reduction of Ag + ions by Kp-EtOH. The GC-MS analysis revealed the presence of 33 bioactive compounds, including beta-amyrin with various pharmacological attributes. The antioxidant potential of Kp- AgNPs was evaluated via DPPH and ABTS assays, while their anti-cancer activity against human hepatocellular carcinoma (HepG2) cells was determined through MTT assay, morphological assessment, DAPI staining, ROS and apoptosis assays. The findings also revealed a reduction in viability of the HepG2 cells associated with elevated ROS levels (p < 0.01), leading to substantial morphological abruptions and apoptotic cell death. Molecular docking studies further established the role of beta-amyrin in modulating the p53/MDM2 regulatory axis. Collectively, these findings support the development of K. pinnata-based AgNPs as herbal therapeutics against HCC, and various other oxidative disorders, thus confirming their role as novel therapeutic agents.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内，肝细胞癌（hepatocellular carcinoma, HCC）是最常见的癌症之一，其治疗方式复杂多样。然而，传统HCC疗法相关的副作用相当严重，这凸显了探索该疾病替代疗法的必要性。本报告聚焦于利用落地生根（Kalanchoe pinnata）乙醇叶提取物（Kp-EtOH）生物合成的银纳米颗粒（silver nanoparticles, AgNPs）的多功能生物潜力，包括其合成、表征及研究。合成的纳米颗粒（Kp-AgNPs）通过动态光散射（dynamic light scattering, DLS）、透射电子显微镜（TEM）和傅里叶变换红外光谱（FTIR）进行表征。结果表明，Kp-AgNPs的平均流体动力学半径为4.74 ± 1.41 nm，zeta电位为23.91 ± 0.75 mV，表明其具有良好的稳定性。TEM图像显示Kp-AgNPs的整体形态为球形，FT-IR分析显示约3200 cm⁻¹处峰变宽，表明Kp-EtOH还原了Ag⁺离子。GC-MS分析揭示了33种生物活性化合物的存在，包括具有多种药理属性的β-香树脂醇（beta-amyrin）。通过DPPH和ABTS实验评估了Kp-AgNPs的抗氧化潜力，同时通过MTT实验、形态学评估、DAPI染色、ROS和凋亡实验测定了其对人类肝细胞癌（HepG2）细胞的抗癌活性。结果还显示，HepG2细胞活力降低与ROS水平升高相关（p < 0.01），导致显著的形态异常和凋亡性细胞死亡。分子对接研究进一步确立了β-香树脂醇在调节p53/MDM2调控轴中的作用。总体而言，这些发现支持将基于落地生根的AgNPs开发为针对HCC及多种氧化性疾病的草药疗法，从而确认其作为新型治疗剂的角色。
